description: The file defines the class 'OneToManyRelationship' which manages metadata for one-to-many relationships in SuiteCRM, extending an abstract relationship class. It includes methods for building subpanel definitions, vardefs, layout fields, and relationship metadata, specific to one-to-many relationship configurations.

classes.name: OneToManyRelationship
classes.description: Class managing metadata for a one-to-many relationship in SuiteCRM, including methods to build subpanel definitions, vardefs, layout fields, and relationship metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the object with relationship definition parameters, calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: buildSubpanelDefinitions
methods.description: Constructs subpanel definitions for the relationship, returning an array with module-specific subpanel info.

methods.name: buildVardefs
methods.description: Builds and returns vardefinitions for the relationship, including link and relate fields.

methods.name: buildFieldsToLayouts
methods.description: Defines which fields to add to module layouts; returns an array keyed by module.

methods.name: buildRelationshipMetaData
methods.description: Generates relationship metadata definitions for the involved modules.
